title: Preparation of 4% Paraformaldehyde (PFA) for Fixation
author: Martin Thomas Jahn
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jtwcnpe

steps.title: Prepare PFA solution
steps.instruction: Wear a mask and handle PFA carefully while making the solution.

substeps.instruction: Pour 2 g paraformaldehyde powder into 50 mL phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS; 130 mM NaCl, 10 mM Na₂HPO₄/NaH₂PO₄, pH 7.4) and adjust the final volume to the amount actually required.
Check the pH of the mixture and adjust it to pH 7.0.

steps.title: Dissolve PFA
steps.instruction: Heat the suspension to approximately 60 °C (do not let it boil) and stir until it becomes clear, about 30 minutes; if the solution remains cloudy, add a few drops of 1 N NaOH.

steps.title: Filter and chill solution
steps.instruction: Pass the clear solution through a 0.2 µm filter and immediately place the filtrate on ice.
